comment: A Channels parameter, offering Independent or Paired, is declared at slice.cpp:339 but never given a panel switch, so it cannot be reached; the two sides run paired. A run of untouched slices gets no fade at all, because it is already continuous and fading it would only cut a hole in it. The window control sweeps from a declick taper to a full grain envelope, and the shape switch only matters near the top of that travel.
